Model evidence & limitations

Relief-demand predictions are trained on synthetic labels. The separate rainfall classifier is evaluated against gridded NASA POWER reanalysis and does not predict flood extent. Offline roads are simplified. Rescue fleet availability is not constrained. Shelter proximity is not evidence of safe access.

Sources & interpretation

  • GCC published ward boundaries — effective boundary date not supplied.
  • OpenStreetMap contributors — bundled river geometries, ODbL attribution.
  • NASA POWER daily weather data — historical gridded reanalysis.
  • CAG 2017 Chennai flood-management audit — historical city context, not validation of these estimates.

Compare scenarios with the same geography and duration when isolating one parameter. A smaller modeled rescue need can arise from different exposure, not necessarily a better response plan.
